title: Conservative habitable-zone screen
explanation: The orbital distance falls inside the project's simplified luminosity-scaled HZ interval.

title: Earth-size radius screen
explanation: The measured radius falls within the configurable 0.8–1.4 Earth-radii screening band.

title: Density available
explanation: Mass and radius are both available, so a bulk-density estimate can be calculated. Density alone does not prove composition.

title: Multiple screening indicators
explanation: The object passes both the simplified HZ and Earth-size screens. This is a shortlist indicator, not a habitability verdict.
